Act Police Station-Mahila Thana, District- Pratapgarh (Contained as Annexure No. 1)
in the interest of justice"

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 On pointing out by Sri Amitabh Chaturvedi, learned counsel for the State that applicant ought to have approached this Court under Section 529 of BNSS for the relief sought, learned counsel for the applicant submitted that he does not want to press this application and the same may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to applicants to file fresh application with proper pleadings and documents in support thereof.
To the aforesaid prayer, there is no objection.
Accordingly, the application is dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.
Office is directed to return the certified copies of the documents as also the original compromise, if any, to the learned counsel for the applicants, as per Rules in this regard.
